resources.string: Waiting for the head unit
Android stopped HSD while clearing apps and ended desktop access. Reactivate using the selected method.
Desktop access has ended. Activate again on the phone or from a computer.
Update DriveDeck
Update DriveDeck to build 359 or later to prevent the launcher from pausing other music players.
The published build predates the playback fix. Choose “Install from file” and select the DriveDeck APK supplied with HSD (build 359 or later).
Default for head units
Head unit
Play a video with speech or a hand clap. When do you hear it through the car speakers?
Sound and picture match
I hear the sound before I see the movement
I see the movement before I hear the sound
Difference in milliseconds (1–%1$d)
HSD aligns the streams automatically. The manual adjustment is zero.
HSD delays audio by this amount. If you hear the clap 0.2 seconds early, enter 200.
HSD reduces its audio wait down to immediate sending. If sound is 0.1 seconds late, enter 100. The head unit may add its own delay.
Applies on the next Android Auto or CarLife connection with audio through HSD. The head unit controls timing for direct Bluetooth playback.
Enable and save
Frame rate limit
Frame rate limit: %1$s
Limits the actual video frame rate. The head unit, connection or phone temperature may lower it further. Applies on the next connection.
Synchronize audio with video
Aligns audio with video in CarLife and Android Auto. Turn off to remove the additional synchronization delay; sound may then precede the picture. Applies on the next connection.
Open HSD to complete or restore activation. USB will start in the background when access is ready.
Open HSD to allow USB access.
